name: Maejima Kaori
source:
She is a third-year student at Shukusei Music Academy, and like Nagisa, is a student in the piano department.
She is also the granddaughter of the chairman of Shukusei Music Academy, and despite her young age, she loves "money and power" and always asserts that she is the chairman's granddaughter.
She has a very harsh personality and a haughty attitude, and sometimes calls Shusaku "Katou."
She is a proud young lady type. She is quite beautiful and likes to dress in mature clothes.
For some reason, she dislikes teacher Minami Ayaka.

[Translated [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku8.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
